data.body: A1 implementation evidence: standard-tier worker completed in 2 production-code attempts. Attempt 1 removed baseline_advanced_at; the orchestrator restored and ran the full oracle: 12/12 happy+edge+E2E checks passed. Exact-defect mutation (re-add the timestamp write) made all 4 held-out edge/E2E nodes RED; restoring it returned 4/4 GREEN. Review then caught the explicit compare-and-return guard missing, and attempt 2 added filtered-baseline equality early return while preserving present-null semantics; full oracle remained 12/12 GREEN. Process deviation: before the corrective dispatch, restored unit edge tests remained in the shared tree, and the worker ran the 11-test unit file despite being told not to inspect held-out material. The edge/E2E oracle had already independently passed against attempt 1, and the exact-defect mutation proof preceded this correction; record this transparently rather than claiming perfect hold-out isolation for attempt 2. Exact source-boundary search now finds no baseline_advanced_at in src/rebar. Module is 743 LOC under the hard 800 cap. Frozen 40-SHA packed-cost rebuild (clone tip d83e9277f420d0135c8e13e67101c53b671edc38, repack -Ad --window=250 --depth=50): before 13.84 KiB/version; A1 transform 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of this baseline, below the <=25% / <=3.20 KiB gate).
